# Plugin Evaluation Kimi

Evaluate plugins and skills with static checks and an optional model judge.

| Maintenance | Dormant |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.1.5 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/plugin-evaluation-kimi) |

**Dormant:** Available as-is, with no planned updates. Existing releases remain installable.

## Example request

> Run only the quick static checks on this skill and explain the findings.

## Requirements

Python-based local evaluator. Kimi/Moonshot is the default model backend; Codex is an optional backend.

- Python 3.12 or newer
- uv and Git
- For optional model judging: Kimi API credentials or an authenticated Codex CLI

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add plugin-evaluation-kimi@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install plugin-evaluation-kimi@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Use quick-depth static evaluation first; it makes no model calls.
- Kimi judging reads PLUGIN_EVAL_KIMI_API_KEY and can consume paid API credits. Select --provider codex for the optional Codex backend, which uses its account allowance.
- Review provider and cost settings before requesting model judging or simulations.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\plugin-evaluation-kimi
/reload
```
